question: What are the three modes by which knowledge unfolds and which powers correspond to them?
premises: Knowledge unfolds by difference, by difference-and-nondifference, and by the full junction of nondifference.
There are three principal powers belonging to Shambhu.
These powers begin with will and correspond to the three modes.
inference: The three principal Shambhu powers of will and so on correspond to the three modes of difference, mixed difference-nondifference, and full nondifference.
plain_english: It unfolds by difference, by difference-and-nondifference, and by the full junction of nondifference; and likewise there are three principal powers of Shambhu, beginning with will.
